manufacturers: Multiple manufacturers including Bausch + Lomb, Alcon, and others

important_note: Dorzolamide is not formulated as oral solid dosage forms (tablets/capsules) in the United States. It is exclusively available as a topical ophthalmic solution for treating elevated intraocular pressure and glaucoma. No pill physical characteristics exist for this medication.
